settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII realism at Dunkirk, late May to early June 1940. British Expeditionary Force POV, wet sand, sea wind, smoke, abandoned vehicles, crowded dunes and evacuation craft. Avoid heroic posing, game-like movement, gore and constant firefights.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. POV faction remains British Expeditionary Force; nearby friendlies are British troops and evacuation personnel. German forces stay distant and clearly opposing. Weapon presentation varies naturally and is often lowered, slung or off-frame during waiting, wading, helping and boarding.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person evacuation reenactment with salt spray, wind-blown fabric, tired body motion, quiet waiting beats, distant air attack tension and cinematic scale reveals.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP06 — Dunkirk: Waiting for the Boats
movie.storySummary: A fictional British soldier retreats through Dunkirk, waits under pressure on the beach, helps another exhausted soldier, wades toward an evacuation craft and finally leaves the coast while looking back at the smoke-covered shoreline.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make the viewer feel physically stranded at Dunkirk as one British soldier. Balance movement, waiting, sea wind, wet boots, sand, distant aircraft, damaged vehicles and the emotional relief of evacuation. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Road to the Coast
scenes.description: Retreat through a French lane toward Dunkirk.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks fast past abandoned British vehicles, rifle slung.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person BEF view on wet French road, abandoned lorries, smoke ahead, muddy boots, rifle sling edge only.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast tired walking, brief glance at abandoned truck. Audio: boots, gear, wind, distant artillery, breathing.

scenes.title: Dunes Ahead
scenes.description: First reveal of the crowded beach through dunes.
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs a sandy rise and sees long lines of British troops on the shore.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dune crest reveal, BEF soldiers below, sea beyond, smoke columns, weapon off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Climb then wide reveal. Audio: wind, surf, distant engines, breath.

scenes.title: Waiting Line
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stands in line, rubbing cold wet hands while the rifle hangs from shoulder.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet gloves and sleeves, British troops queued ahead, gray sea, no active firing nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still human sway. Audio: surf, wind, fabric, distant aircraft, breathing.

scenes.title: Aircraft Shadow
scenes.description: Tension rises as aircraft pass overhead.
scenes.actionDescription: He looks up as aircraft shadows cross the beach and troops crouch.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person upward view, gray sky, distant aircraft, British soldiers ducking below.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick tilt up then drop lower. Audio: aircraft engines, surf, sand, muffled distant impacts.

scenes.title: After the Pass
scenes.actionDescription: He sits briefly beside a sand ridge and checks a torn boot lace.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person seated view, hands fixing muddy boot lace, rifle resting beside leg, sea spray on gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Still close detail. Audio: surf, breath, faint ringing-like dullness fading to wind.

scenes.title: Help Him Up
scenes.actionDescription: He extends one hand to help an exhausted British soldier stand from the sand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand reaching to another BEF sleeve and web gear, non-graphic fatigue only.
scenes.videoPrompt: One hand pull and balance shift. Audio: strained breathing, boots in sand, surf.

scenes.title: The Mole
scenes.description: A distant evacuation route becomes visible.
scenes.actionDescription: He looks toward the mole where troops move toward larger ships.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person beach panorama, long mole, distant ships, smoke and troop lines.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan to mole and hold. Audio: surf, engines, wind, distant naval sounds.

scenes.title: Little Boat
scenes.description: A small civilian craft approaches offshore.
scenes.actionDescription: He shades his eyes and watches a small evacuation boat approach through chop.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloved hand shielding eyes, small boat offshore, gray waves, British troops watching.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle zoom-like push toward boat. Audio: waves, small engine, wind.

scenes.title: Into the Water
scenes.description: The line moves toward a shallow boarding point.
scenes.actionDescription: He wades knee-deep through cold water with rifle held above splash level.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person legs in surf, wet trousers, rifle high and offset, small craft ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow wading with wave resistance. Audio: splashing, surf, gear, hard breathing.

scenes.title: Boarding Hand
scenes.actionDescription: A crew hand grabs his wrist and pulls him aboard.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand-to-hand boarding, wet gunwale, British sleeves, sea below.
scenes.videoPrompt: One upward pull with body-weight motion. Audio: hull knocks, water, engine, breath.

scenes.title: Deck Floor
scenes.description: A quiet recovery on the boat deck.
scenes.actionDescription: He sits on wet deck, hands trembling slightly while water drips from sleeves.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet knees, shaking gloved hands, cramped British soldiers nearby, rifle laid safely along deck.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still low POV. Audio: engine, hull vibration, water drips, breathing.

scenes.title: Leaving Shore
scenes.description: The boat pulls away from Dunkirk.
scenes.actionDescription: He turns to look back at the beach shrinking behind.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person over stern, Dunkirk beach and smoke receding, troops still visible as lines.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn and hold on retreating coast. Audio: engine, waves, wind.

scenes.title: Share Water
scenes.description: A small human recovery gesture aboard.
scenes.actionDescription: He passes a canteen to the exhausted soldier he helped earlier.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person canteen handoff between British uniforms, wet deck, no speech.
scenes.videoPrompt: Simple handoff. Audio: canteen, engine, breath, sea.

scenes.title: Open Channel
scenes.actionDescription: He stands carefully and grips the rail as open water fills the view.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand gripping wet rail, Channel water, distant French coast behind haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise to standing and steady horizon. Audio: wind, engine, waves.

scenes.title: Not the End
scenes.description: Evacuation ends the episode without triumphalism.
scenes.actionDescription: He looks down at salt-stained hands, then back toward the horizon ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands on rail, wet uniform cuffs, gray horizon toward Britain, rifle out of frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Look down then lift to horizon and hold. Audio: waves, engine, tired breathing. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite British Expeditionary Force infantryman
characters.description: Anonymous British soldier during the Dunkirk evacuation, 1940.
characters.mainOutfit: BEF battledress, Mk II helmet, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain British. German forces remain distant and separate. Preserve wet clothing, sand, fatigue and equipment continuity.

atmosphereAssets.title: Approach Road and Dunes
atmosphereAssets.description: Wet French roads, abandoned British vehicles, dunes and smoke.

atmosphereAssets.title: Dunkirk Beach
atmosphereAssets.description: Long troop lines, wet sand, surf, distant mole and evacuation craft.

atmosphereAssets.title: Evacuation Craft and Channel
atmosphereAssets.description: Small craft, wet deck, gray waves and receding French coast.
